I had many dreams. I thought in travelling around the world and meeting many cultures and people. I have always felt love and compassion for the animals. My goal was to have my own shelter. When I saw an animal in the street suffering from cold, I couldn't avoid crying and told myself that I would change that.

When I was between 5 and 8 years old, only child, my parents often took me on a trip. We stayed at beautiful hotels. My father made me think that each hotel where we stayed, it was my own house. I felt really happy in those days. It was very funny to believe that all hotel workers were our employees. Definitely, my father made me live a beautiful fantasy. Maybe, that's why I dreamed of opening my own hotel.

And of course, that wasn't everything. I also yearned for genuine love. I imagined a romantic and gentlemanly man, who loved animals as I did. But, I didn't get anything. I wish I could go back in time and change the decisions I made. Now I'm 50 years old. I believe it's a little late for me. Or do you think I still have time?...
